captures.q: Leon Levy Dead Sea Scrolls Digital Library
captures.description: THE LEON LEVY DEAD SEA SCROLLS DIGITAL LIBRARY, BY NAME, ON GOOGLE'S AI OVERVIEW, SIGNED OUT, 2026-10-31: 'a free, searchable online database created by the Israel Antiquities Authority in partnership with Google.' Multispectral imaging at '12 different wavelengths', thousands of fragments 'discovered in the Judean Desert between 1947 and the early 1960s', search filters, the P.A.M. negatives, the library's link. Six cards: the library's own site, a blog, the Hebrew University, two IAA videos, the Friends of the IAA.

atoms.evidence: The Leon Levy Dead Sea Scrolls Digital Library is a free, searchable online database
created by the Israel Antiquities Authority
Preserves thousands of ancient scroll fragments and hundreds of manuscripts discovered in the Judean Desert between 1947 and the early 1960s
Massive Archive: Preserves thousands of ancient scroll fragments
P.A.M. Negatives: Includes digital scans of historic Palestine Archaeological Museum photographic negatives from the 1950s.
